resultat: Dan Henderson bat Maurício Rua par décision unanime après 5 rounds.
resultat_en: Dan Henderson defeats Maurício Rua by unanimous decision after 5 rounds.
contexte: Cinq rounds entre Dan Henderson et Maurício Rua, gagnés aux points par Henderson : combat de la soirée, décrit par beaucoup comme l'un des plus grands de l'histoire de l'UFC.
contexte_en: Five rounds between Dan Henderson and Maurício Rua, won on points by Henderson: Fight of the Night, described by many as one of the greatest fights in UFC history.
